checks.name: Every original record ID has exactly one indexed detail in its own layer
All 72 result screens retain all 724 claim IDs, 313 event IDs, source IDs and raw date labels
Every selection, reference, review and local record screen renders
Official report classification remains separate from result evidence
Review event sources all have matching visible source anchors
Result context, evaluation, challenges and target gaps appear on every reviewed detail
Filters return exact input memberships and keep training separate
Pagination reaches every selection and reference without truncation
Plans do not become results; corrected cross-year rates and latency denominator stay intact
Public projections have no Drive links, private input ids, credentials, external scripts or source maps
Default data requests stay below 100KB and never load raw 24MB JSON
Oversized number emphasis preserves original text, units and dates
